translation: What Would You Like To Be?

phrase: سأل المعلم التلاميذ مرة في الصف واحدا واحدا
translation: The teacher once asked the pupils in class, one by one

phrase: وقال: كل واحد حر في جوابه
translation: and he said: each one is free in his answer
so let him not be afraid or shy
Ahmad, who was the youngest of the pupils, said

phrase: أنا أريد أن أكون سائقا في القطار
translation: I want to be a driver on the train
so I can always ride, travel free and enjoy myself
Abdur-Rahman said

phrase: إن سائق القطار في تعب عظيم وحر وجحيم
translation: the train driver is in great fatigue, heat and inferno

phrase: ولكني أحب أن أكون ربانا في باخرة
translation: but I would like to be a captain on a steamship
so I can travel the sea
visit distant lands free of charge
and behold the wonders of the world
Ibrahim said

phrase: الربان وباخرته في خطر من الغرق
translation: the captain and his steamship are in danger of sinking
but I would like to be a doctor
so I can treat people, and treat the poor for free
serve creation and look after my health
and live in safety and peace

phrase: وأجابه عبد الرحمن وقال: هذا ليس بصحيح
translation: Abdur-Rahman answered him and said: that is not correct

phrase: ليست الباخرة في خطر في هذا الزمان
translation: the steamship is not in danger in this age

phrase: والبواخر تسافر دائما في هذه الأيام بأمن وسلام
translation: steamships these days always travel in safety and peace
and on the contrary I see doctors falling ill and dying
Ibrahim interrupted him and said

phrase: أما سمعت أن باخرة غرقت قبل يومين أو ثلاثة أيام
translation: have you not heard that a steamship sank two or three days ago?

phrase: وأراد إبراهيم أن يجيبه ولكن قال المعلم
translation: Ibrahim wanted to answer him, but the teacher said
this is not the time for a debate
and many pupils still remain
and what do you say, Qasim?

phrase: قال قاسم: أنا لا أحب أن أكون سائقا أو ربانا أو طبيبا
translation: Qasim said: I would not like to be a driver, a captain or a doctor
rather I would like to be a farmer
planting and ploughing

phrase: ولا أحد يخدم الناس وينفعهم كالفلاح
translation: no one serves people and benefits them like the farmer
he is the one who grows the grains and vegetables
so that people and beasts may eat

phrase: وقال سليمان: أنا أحب أن أكون تاجرا
translation: Sulayman said: I would like to be a merchant

phrase: لي دكان كبير في سوق كبيرة
translation: with a big shop in a big market
people coming to me and buying

phrase: وقال حامد: أنا أحب أن أكون صناعا ماهرا ومخترعا
translation: Hamid said: I would like to be a skilled craftsman and an inventor
making and inventing wondrous things

phrase: وقال خالد: أنا أحب أن أكون جنديا قويا
translation: Khalid said: I would like to be a strong soldier
fighting the disbelievers and polytheists
and striving in the path of Allah

phrase: وقال عبد الكريم: أنا أحب أن أكون غنيا كبيرا
translation: Abdul-Karim said: I would like to be greatly rich

phrase: ألبس ما أحب وآكل ما أشتهي
translation: wearing what I like and eating what I fancy
and travelling wherever I want
always having much wealth
and living in a great palace

phrase: وضحك الأولاد من قول عبد الكريم
translation: the boys laughed at Abdul-Karim's words
and Abdul-Karim was embarrassed

phrase: وقال محمد: أنا أحب أن أكون عالما
translation: Muhammad said: I would like to be a scholar
fearing Allah and worshipping Him
exhorting people and enjoining them to good

phrase: وأنهاهم عن المنكر وأحذرهم عذاب الله
translation: forbidding them from evil and warning them of Allah's punishment
the teacher said: well done, my children
and I pray for you for success and prosperity
but be Muslims
and seek Allah through your work
benefit the religion through your occupation
and serve the ummah with your knowledge

phrase: قال التلاميذ: وماذا تقول أيها الأستاذ
translation: the pupils said: and what do you say, teacher
about Abdul-Karim and his palace?

phrase: قال المعلم: المال نعمة من الله يجب عليها الشكر
translation: the teacher said: wealth is a blessing from Allah for which thanks are due

phrase: وسعيد جدا من آتاه الله مالا
translation: truly happy is he whom Allah gives wealth
and he spends from it secretly and openly
seeking by it the pleasure of Allah
and serving Islam with it
it has come in the noble hadith
there is no envy except in two cases

phrase: رجل آتاه الله مالا فسلطه على هلكته في الحق
translation: a man whom Allah gave wealth and enabled him to spend it fully in the right cause

phrase: ورجل آتاه الله حكمة فهو يقضي بها ويعلمها
translation: and a man whom Allah gave wisdom, so he judges by it and teaches it
our master Uthman was rich

phrase: وسيدنا عبد الرحمن بن عوف غنيا
translation: and our master Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf was rich
Abdul-Karim raised his head and said
I will strive to serve Islam with my wealth
and to seek by it the pleasure of Allah
